topic: Running LLMs on Android: Memory Is the Bottleneck
caption:
📰 Running LLMs on Android: Memory Is the Bottleneck

On-device LLM inference is blocked by mobile memory limits, not compute. Quantization (4-bit/3-bit) and memory-mapped weight loading via MLC LLM and llama.cpp enable 7B models to run in 4GB RAM. This unlocks private, offline AI for Android apps.
